title: SIDAN | Waffle - Hong Kong Cardano Community

ms.promise: Organise an annual meetup and invite Cardano Hong Kong Community members to join to be updated on Cardano roadmap and upcoming global events (e.g., Cardano Summit). Stronger connections among builders, users, and stakeholders.
ms.criteria:
Meetup Topic: Cardano Hong Kong Annual Meetup
・Number of Cardano Community builders/contributors to speak at the event: 2-3 (Including SIDAN Lab)
・Duration: Minimum 2 hours, briefly covering: Introduction to Cardano (for new joiners). Current Highlights of Cardano, Upcoming Cardano Events & Community Activities, other organisation sharing(subject to other party availability); Mainly for community Networking
・Attendance: Minimum 35 guests
・Feedback: All attendees will be invited to complete a feedback form to gather insights and event evaluation
ms.report:
Please refer to the supporting materials and evidence provided for Milestone 1.
The meetup attracted 40+ registered participants and brought together Cardano builders, community members, and ecosystem enthusiasts. Neal from SIDAN Lab shared Cardano ecosystem updates, upcoming events, and introduced the Catalyst Pilot Scheme. Guest speakers Leo from Hizz (Taiwan), Newt from Strike Finance, and Oscar from GI also shared their projects, experiences, and perspectives with the community.
